# Generated by vickers_build.py (shared Commonwealth Vickers). Edit the generator, not this file.

# Partner country scope: copy one trait.
ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_mk1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk1 }
		}
		set_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk1
		mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = {
			# the copy adds +1 size; count it so the size-up hook skips it instead of paying the UK
			if = {
				limit = { has_mio_flag = vickers_copy_pending }
				modify_mio_flag = { flag = vickers_copy_pending value = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_mio_flag = { flag = vickers_copy_pending value = 1 }
			}
			complete_mio_trait = { trait = ENG_vickers_mk1 show_modifiers = no }
		}
	}
}

# Partner country scope: bring its Vickers copy level with the UK's.
ENG_vickers_sync_partner = {
	mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { set_mio_flag = vickers_partner_copy }
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk1 } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_mk1 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk2_aec } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_mk2_aec = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk3 } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_mk3 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk4_gmc } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_mk4_gmc = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk5 } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_mk5 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk6 } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_mk6 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk7a } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_mk7a = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk8 } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_mk8 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk9 } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_mk9 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk10 } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_mk10 = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk11_75mm } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_mk11_75mm = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_railway_works } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_railway_works = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_reliability } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_reliability = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_for_russia } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_for_russia = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_home_army } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_home_army = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_chassis_commonality } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_chassis_commonality = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_archer } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_archer = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_bishop } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_bishop = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_dd } }
		ENG_vickers_copy_ENG_vickers_dd = yes
	}
	# hidden techs for the copied module traits
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk2_aec
			NOT = { has_tech = oak_vickers_aec_diesel_tech }
		}
		set_technology = { oak_vickers_aec_diesel_tech = 1 popup = no }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk3
			NOT = { has_tech = oak_vickers_valentine_turret_tech }
		}
		set_technology = { oak_vickers_valentine_turret_tech = 1 popup = no }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk8
			NOT = { has_tech = oak_vickers_6pdr_tech }
		}
		set_technology = { oak_vickers_6pdr_tech = 1 popup = no }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_mk11_75mm
			NOT = { has_tech = oak_vickers_75mm_tech }
		}
		set_technology = { oak_vickers_75mm_tech = 1 popup = no }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_archer
			NOT = { has_tech = oak_vickers_archer_mount_tech }
		}
		set_technology = { oak_vickers_archer_mount_tech = 1 popup = no }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_dd
			NOT = { has_tech = oak_vickers_valentine_dd_tech }
		}
		set_technology = { oak_vickers_valentine_dd_tech = 1 popup = no }
	}
	# Bishop's research bonus, once
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = vickers_got_ENG_vickers_bishop
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ENG_vickers_bishop_bonus_given }
		}
		set_country_flag = ENG_vickers_bishop_bonus_given
		add_tech_bonus = {
			name = ENG_vickers_bishop_bonus
			bonus = 0.75
			uses = 1
			category = armor
		}
	}
}

# Partner Vickers MIO scope, right after it grew a size from its own production:
# pass 50% of what that size cost on to the UK's copy.
ENG_vickers_contribute = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 39 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 15700 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 38 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 15300 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 37 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 14900 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 36 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 14500 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 35 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 14100 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 34 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 13700 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 33 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 13300 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 32 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 12900 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 31 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 12500 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 30 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 12100 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 29 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 11700 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 28 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 11300 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 27 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 10900 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 26 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 10500 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 25 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 10100 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 24 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 9700 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 23 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 9300 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 22 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 8900 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 21 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 8500 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 20 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 8100 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 19 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 7700 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 18 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 7300 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 17 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 6900 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 16 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 6500 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 15 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 6100 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 14 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 5700 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 13 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 5300 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 12 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 4900 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 11 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 4500 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 10 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 4100 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 9 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 3700 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 8 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 3300 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 7 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 2900 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 6 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 2500 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 5 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 2100 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 4 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 1700 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 3 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 1300 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 2 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 900 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_mio_size > 1 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 500 } }
	}
	else = {
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = 100 } }
	}
}

# Partner country scope, monthly (followers only): pass 50% of the funds its Vickers copy
# collected to the UK's copy, then empty it. Copies make a partner as big as the UK, so its own size-ups get
# very expensive and would pay out rarely; paying monthly keeps the bloc's contribution steady all war.
ENG_vickers_pay_uk = {
	mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { set_temp_variable = { vickers_funds = funds } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { vickers_funds > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { vickers_pay = vickers_funds }
		multiply_temp_variable = { vickers_pay = 0.5 }
		ENG = { mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { add_mio_funds = var:vickers_pay } }
		mio:ENG_vickers_armstrong_eng_organization = { set_mio_funds = 0 }
	}
}
